name: integration
description: Integration arm: stand the built image + its dependencies up and test them for real. clone -> compose agent writes docker-compose.yml -> integration-test agent writes tests/integration.sh -> run step (on the privileged kata microVM class, image docker:27-dind) starts dockerd, `docker compose up --build`, runs the tests against the live app at http://localhost:8080, then tears down. Needs forge FORGE_ALLOW_PRIVILEGED_KATA=1 + the kata-build runner class (see forge-privileged-kata-switch). Inputs {namespace, repo, ref, project}.

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}"; echo cloned; git log --oneline -1

with.task: Write docker-compose.yml to run repo ${inputs.repo} and the dependencies its code actually uses. Build the app service (named app) from the local Dockerfile and publish it on host port 8080.
Write tests/integration.sh: black-box HTTP integration tests for repo ${inputs.repo} hitting the running service at TARGET_URL (default http://localhost:8080).

with.run: set -e; export DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR=""; ( dockerd-entrypoint.sh dockerd ) >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 40); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'dockerd did not start'; tail -50 /tmp/dockerd.log; exit 1; }; echo "dockerd up"; apk add --no-cache curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; cd /workspace; [ -f docker-compose.yml ] || [ -f compose.yaml ] || { echo 'no compose file from the compose agent'; exit 1; }; [ -f tests/integration.sh ] || { echo 'no tests/integration.sh from the integration-test agent'; exit 1; }; echo '=== docker-compose.yml ==='; cat docker-compose.yml 2>/dev/null || cat compose.yaml; set +e; echo '=== compose up --build --wait ==='; docker compose up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 120; echo "compose up rc=$?"; echo '=== compose ps ==='; docker compose ps; export TARGET_URL=http://localhost:8080; echo '=== integration tests (TARGET_URL=http://localhost:8080) ==='; sh tests/integration.sh; rc=$?; echo '=== compose ps (post) ==='; docker compose ps; echo '=== app logs (tail) ==='; docker compose logs --tail=80 2>&1 | tail -80; docker compose down -v >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "integration result: $rc"; exit $rc
